projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: The top-level folders of the vault. Visibility says who reads a project: private (accounts with a grant), internal (every user) or public (every account, read-only ones included); writing and administering always take a grant, to an account or a team (Access). Your own level shows on each row. The flags: skip-git leaves the project out of git sync; hidden keeps it out of reach of MCP agents; globals merges the shared global skills and agents at bootstrap; anchors writes the vault's agents as local subagent files at bootstrap (both need their switch on the server, dimmed when off); tag-vocab lets the project extend the tag vocabulary of the lint from memory/conventions.md; lean-read gives tokens that cannot write a shorter bootstrap; mirror lets readers keep a read-only copy of the project (the notes leave the server, every sync is audited).
